title: TeachBuddy reliability candidate.3
description: F60@1 authored candidate, not frozen. $defs are the unique added shapes; x-http binds HTTP, x-tool-bindings binds frozen business operations. Authentication and business invariants remain in their fixed contracts.

x-auth-recovery.consumer: F62 offline restore; D71 reuses it
x-auth-recovery.runtimeInput: Fixed implementation/self SHA and A10 implementation handoff required before F62; not supplied by design acceptance
x-auth-recovery.resultAuthority: Return fields, counts, error codes and supported auth migrations belong solely to contract above; no duplicate DTO here
x-auth-recovery.manifestSemantics: DeploymentManifest records backup-time facts; per-restore auth results and prepared/active evidence belong to the restore report, never the source manifest
x-auth-recovery.activation: restore prepares an isolated target; server.js --activate-restored <recoveryId> explicitly activates the same prepared deployment set; ordinary restart never clears auth

x-http-common.authentication: auth 1.0.0-rc.2 Cookie + X-TeachBuddy-Page; writes original source/protection headers and Idempotency-Key
x-http-common.newReadSideEffects: none except original documented defaults; GET exports sorted createdAt descending then id ascending

AgentToolOutcome.description: v2 runtime adapter details；所有字段必填。read/confirmed 仅 result 非空，read operationId=null；confirmed/unconfirmed operationId 非空；rejected/failed/unconfirmed 仅 problem 非空；cancelled/interrupted result/problem=null，interrupted operationId=null。C25 历史 toolResult 保持原格式。

migrationIds.description: 备份时完整有序迁移账本；与实际库及固定候选支持集合逐项核对，未知模块/ID 或缺升级链即停止；认证子集只按 x-auth-recovery 的固定契约。

DeploymentManifest.description: 备份时事实，不含秘密或可复用的认证清理/开放许可。认证操作绑定见 x-auth-recovery；具体配置及兼容/启用顺序归 reliability 架构和契约 E。schemas 列举全部必需内容/数学/Agent 格式版本，版本未知即停止，不能仅凭认证操作成功开放。

DraftEnvelope.description: 仅设备存储。formJson/bodyJson 是完整原始 JSON 字符串，不是信任的可执行请求；sourceContract 取 x-sources 中源文件及版本。上传中的 File 字节不在此对象。

LayoutExport.description: 仅个人包的只读投影，源为固定 P core/workspaceLayout.js 的 toPublicLayout；不新增或改变布局写 API。
